summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing it amended and restated its syndicated secured revolving credit facility (RCF), extending the maturity by three years to June 30, 2029, while maintaining availability at $800 million (with an accordion feature increasing the upsize limit from $50 million to $200 million). The company also maintains a $70 million unsecured LC facility. This is a routine refinancing/credit extension, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other corporate event is involved.
